question: Small marks of the editor chrome: where a dragged block panel can go, how the grid is drawn, the layers of a block, hover, handles and the label pill, and more as items need them.
how: real mouse input in headless Chrome on the demo page, plus DOM reads and screenshots. Nothing was saved: every run ended with Exit, and when the holds had changed the page, with Exit in the Exit Without Saving dialog.

panelMove.note: Shape block's Edit panel. A drag follows the pointer inside limits that depend on the window, not on the editor area. Escape closes it; it reopens at its first place.

grid.drawn: one absolute div per grid row (grid-area r / 1 / r / -1, as wide as the section), z-index auto, holding one absolute svg with a pattern and a rect filled by it
grid.svg: height 100%, left L, width calc(100% - (2L - 1)px), where L is the first track plus the column gap, rounded
grid.pattern: width (svg width + gap - 1) / columns, height 100%, patternUnits userSpaceOnUse
grid.cell: rect x 0.5, y 0.5, rx 3, stroke-width 1, stroke #B7B7B7, fill #F2F2F240, width tile - gap - 1, height row height - 1
grid.fade: in: opacity 0 to 0.65, transition opacity 0.1s ease-in, sampled at 0.33, 0.48, 0.65 over about 100 ms. Out: the first sample after the drop already reads 0, 46 ms later (one sample)
grid.startsAt: Below the 10px drag start the rows are in the page at opacity 0, on every section and with height 31 on the rect; nothing shows. The drag sets the height above and shows them

boxOnlyAlso.note: read before the drag starts, so with no cell height

grid.pixels: Same demo section, same scroll, 14px hold at 1600 by 1000: in the box x 100 to 860, y 400 to 700 of the window (empty cells only) ours and the oracle differ by 0 in every color channel. Phone: one row across the cells, x 586 to 1014, the same but for the 3 pixels of the oracle's center line (x 799 to 801), which ours does not draw on phones
grid.phoneRows: How many rows a phone hold shows is not settled: 14 after two desktop holds in the same session, 20 on the first hold of a fresh session. Ours shows 14. The look of a cell is the same in both

layers.outer: 100000 + z at the block's box, border 3px transparent. Holds the near and matching marks (parity/findings/NEAR.json). Always in the page, draws nothing at rest
layers.inner: 10000 + z at the block's box, inset 3px; 999999 when it is the one selected block. Holds the two rings and the handles. Transition on width, height, transform 0.15s linear, but no glide seen: at the drop its top changes in one step (rAF samples)
layers.groupMember: a block in a group stays at 10000 + z
layers.label: group 1000000, tag 1001
layers.ours: Ours keeps these numbers on what it draws: the marks at 100000 + z, the hover and group member rings at 10000 + z, the selection and group box at 999999, the label at 1000000. Layers that draw nothing are not in the page

rings.hover: the same as selected: 1px rgb(2, 122, 255) 1px outside the block, 1px rgb(108, 164, 244) 2px outside. Pixels read on the shape's left and right edges
rings.selected: the same rings, unchanged by hovering it or by text editing (entered with the toolbar's Write button)
rings.groupMember: 1px rgba(2, 122, 255, 0.49) 1px outside, 1px rgba(72, 148, 255, 0.7) 2px outside; no change on hover
rings.groupBox: 2px rgb(2, 122, 255) touching the group box, then 1px rgb(72, 148, 255) outside it

handles.hit: 34 by 34, takes the pointer, z 2 in the layer, cursors nw, ne, se, sw-resize, row-resize, col-resize. The 11px edge bars do not take the pointer
handles.mark: 10 by 10 in the middle of the hit box, white, 2px solid rgb(2, 122, 255), radius 0
handles.center: on the 1px-outside ring: corners at the block's corner 1px out, sides at the middle
handles.perType: all eight on text, shape, button, line, scrolling, image, video, accordion, form, code and embed; they stay while a text block is edited
handles.group: eight, hit 34 by 34, centers 2px outside the group box
handles.phone: In Mobile View the same 34px boxes at the same offsets from the block

labels.box: 22px above the block's top, at its left. Tag height 16, padding 0 8px, 500 9.75px/16px Clarkson, letter-spacing 0.75px, uppercase, rgb(2, 122, 255) on white text; group radius 3
labels.shows: opacity 1 on hover with no fade (samples go 0 to 1 and back in one step), 0 when the block is selected or in a group, also on hover
labels.otherBlockHovered: a hovered block shows its ring and pill also while another block is selected or being text edited
labels.strip: The group box is in the page at opacity 0 and takes the pointer: over it a block underneath gets no hover and the cursor is auto. A click there selects nothing and deselects
labels.nearTheTop: The pill keeps its place above the block when the block's top is near or past the top of the frame; there it is cut off. A floated pill exists in the page but stayed display none in every read
labels.lab: Video, Accordion, Line, Code and Embed read on a block added to an empty page with a new section, nothing saved
labels.phone: In Mobile View the same: pill 0, -22 from the block, 52.1 by 16 on the shape; rings the same; layers 10003, then 999999 when selected

pixels.selected: Shape selected at the same scroll, ours against the oracle: both ring columns and the handles are the same pixels. x 1440 differs because the shape's own right edge is drawn with another blend
pixels.group: Marquee on heading and paragraph: left, right and member lines the same pixels
pixels.pill: box the same but for the letters: Clarkson is not in the repo (O2), so ours falls back to Helvetica

notMeasured: the group's handle hit box beyond the top left corner
the pill label of a stack: ours says Stack
